subject: No Boost = Not Burnout!
author: ZombieTron
body:
I have bought the cops and robbers pack, and it is fun, a great online game mode which probably should have been in the game from day 1... but anyway it's here now. But, I really don't understand why there is no boost?

subject: It includes all of the previous updates
author: ZombieTron
body:
You can delete the other updates from your hard drive to clear some space, but yes, it is BIG!

It includes:

Cagney - The changes made within Cagney included ranked racing changes, online timed challenges and game modes; stunt run, road rage and marked man as well as the boost-less cars and some new liveries.

The Bike Pack - Bikes, freeburn challenges for bikes, day/night cycle.. and fog!

1.6 - The refinements pack and party pack, this changes the way Paradise looks.

1.7 - The DLC car packs; Legendary, Toy and Boost Specials

1.8 - All of the above (on Xbox 360) and new bug fixes as described above along with the Cops & Robbers pack.

Phew! all of that lot is a lot of mega bytes! 🙂
